This caused connection failures through the Service. The incident was resolved by patching the Service targetPort to match the backend listening port 8081.

The deployment was patched to select storage=nvme and tolerate dedicated=reports:NoSchedule, successfully completing the rollout.

The inventory-controller pod in namespace proofix-case-09 was failing to reconcile because its bound Role (inventory-settings-reader) granted permissions only for 'pods' instead of 'configmaps', denying access to the required inventory-settings ConfigMap. The Role has been patched with least-privilege access granting ConfigMap permissions, and auth checks verify that the inventory-controller ServiceAccount is now authorized.

The RBAC deficit affecting inventory-controller has been identified and resolved. The inventory-controller pod runs with ServiceAccount inventory-controller bound to Role inventory-settings-reader via RoleBinding inventory-settings-reader in namespace proofix-case-09. The Role originally lacked permissions for the inventory-settings ConfigMap. The Role was patched with the required ConfigMap permissions, and auth can-i verification confirmed get access on configmaps/inventory-settings is now allowed for the inventory-controller ServiceAccount.

The deployment was patched to select storage=nvme and tolerate dedicated=reports:NoSchedule with effect NoSchedule, successfully completing the rollout.

The incident was caused by a credential secret desynchronization between the database and the billing application. The database password was rotated to authoritative generation b9b26c30a42a65968efab3834749fdbf83374b60e371d95d1dc3ee3e8fd2a5ee (held in db-credentials), while the billing-api Deployment and running pod were consuming the stale credential generation 0aab604799348439ce4cc92447e78eebc30206aee3d5625982cddfd410238f40 from billing-credentials (resource version 113923). Network connectivity to PostgreSQL was healthy, but authentication was rejected by the database. The issue was resolved by synchronizing billing-credentials to the authoritative credential generation (digest b9b26c30a42a65968efab3834749fdbf83374b60e371d95d1dc3ee3e8fd2a5ee) and executing a controlled rollout of the billing-api Deployment.
